LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_EnableNewContent_Tooltip: New Hunger and Havoc incidents and visitors stop appearing. Visitors already here keep begging, trading, stealing, or leaving.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Relief_Note: Visitors look for food they can reach inside the marked cells. Food outside, the limit after a meal, and leaving are set below.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ReliefEnabled_Tooltip: Visitors ignore the marked cells. A zone already drawn stays on the map.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_EatOutsideRelief: Allow food outside the relief zone
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_EatOutsideRelief_Tooltip: Visitors may only eat food they can reach inside the zone. With none, they beg, wait, or leave.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_IgnoreReliefAfterFed: Ignore the relief zone after eating
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_IgnoreReliefAfterFed_Toolt: After a visitor is full, their next meal may come from outside the zone. With this off, a full visitor is no longer fed by this mod.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_LeaveAfterFed_Tooltip: A visitor who can reach an exit leaves after eating. A child too young to walk is carried out. With this off, a full visitor stays.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_MaxEventPawns_Tooltip: Adults, children, Ratkin young, and animals in one event stay under this number. Range 1 to 100, default 30. A count below the event minimum still uses that minimum. A fixed mother and child group is not split.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ReliefScore_Tooltip: Food inside the zone also gains this bonus, on top of distance and whether it is suitable. Range 0 to 100%, default 10%.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_FedStay_Tooltip: After the first full meal, each visitor stays for half to one and a half times this duration, then leaves. Range 0 to 5 days, default half a day. Turning leaving off keeps the record of who has already eaten.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_WaitFood: Wait when no food is found
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_WaitFood_Tooltip: Visitors keep looking for the set time. Food found later starts the next wait over. With this off, they leave.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_FoodWait_Tooltip: How long a visitor waits after finding nothing to eat. Range 0 to 5 days, default half a day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Age_Tooltip: Ordinary visitors are generated inside this range. Range 0 to 100, default 0 to 50. Ratkin young, fixed ages, and mothers keep the age the event requires. Without Toddlers, only event infants ignore age-based immobility. Injury, pain, and consciousness still drop them.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ShelterDays_Tooltip: A sheltered visitor leaves when the time is up. Range 5 to 60 days, default 5. A downed visitor stays on the map and resumes the remaining time.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_HireDays_Tooltip: A hired visitor leaves when the time is up. Range 5 to 600 days, default 60. A downed visitor stays on the map and resumes the remaining time.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ColdClothes: Give new visitors a cold wrap
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ColdClothes_Tooltip: When the map is colder than a visitor can bear, a new visitor wears one extra cold wrap. With this off, no extra clothing is given.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Temp_Tooltip: New map incidents stop while the map is outside this range. Default -35°C to 70°C. Caravans ignore it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ReliefFoods_Tooltip: Visitors may take any food left on. Disabling all only turns off foods loaded now. Foods added later stay available.
LanguageData.RHAH_ReliefArea_Expand_Desc: Mark cells where visitors may take food. An empty zone does not become the whole map.
LanguageData.RHAH_ReliefArea_Clear_Desc: Remove marked cells. Once none remain, visitors who cannot leave the zone stop taking food here.
LanguageData.RHAH_PlagueSpreading: Ratkin plague is spreading through the colony.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Settings_Missing: Settings are not ready. Reopen this page and try again.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Events_Note: A checked incident can fire. The slider sets a rough value. Type the exact value on the right. Debug points change the number of arrivals and the size of a request. A spawn weight of 0 stays out of the draw.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_EventEnabled_Tip: With this off, the incident stays out of the draw and cannot be queued from the debug page. Visitors already here stay.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_DebugPoints_Tip: Natural fires and debug triggers use this size. It changes how many pawns arrive and how much aid or intel asks for. Range 1 to 10000. The slider is rough. The field is exact.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_IncidentWeight_Tip: 100 keeps the catalog weight. Higher is drawn more often. 0 stays out. The slider is rough. The field is exact.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Queue_Queued: Queued. It spawns after this menu closes.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_DevEvents_Note: Queues this incident instead of waiting for the natural draw. It spawns after the menu closes and the game is running again.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Pawns_None: No Hunger and Havoc pawns on this map.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_NoGame: Narrative state needs a loaded game.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Ending_Gap: Ending switches are not implemented. This page does not write an ending.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_Gap: Biotech gene settings are not implemented. This page does not edit genes.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_NoBiotech: Biotech is required. With it, you can set the xenotypes of visitors here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_Note: The percent after the name is the current chance. The slider sets a rough weight. Type the exact value on the right, from 0 to 100. A xenotype at 0 stays out of the draw. At all zeroes, visitors use the base ratkin xenotype. If that xenotype is missing, they use the famine ratkin xenotype.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_Fallback: The enabled weights add up to 0. Visitors use the base ratkin xenotype. If that xenotype is missing, they use the famine ratkin xenotype.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_WeightTip: Suggested weight {1}. Chance is this weight divided by the sum of enabled weights.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Genes_NoOwned: No Hunger and Havoc genes are available to toggle.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnHistory_Note: New visitors draw one checked history by developmental stage, age, temperature, and incident. An incident that sets its own backstory keeps it. Traits can still be drawn.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnHistory_ItemTip: With this off, the history stays out of the draw. Pawns already generated keep theirs.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnTrait_ItemTip: With this off, the trait stays out of the draw. Pawns already generated keep theirs.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_PawnTrait_WeightTip: A higher weight is drawn more often. 0 stays out. After the draw, weight divided by 100 is the chance to gain it. The slider is rough. The field is exact.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PawnHistories_Tooltip: With this off, new visitors keep the backstory from the generator. Pawns already here keep theirs.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PawnTraits_Tooltip: With this off, new visitors gain no mod trait. Pawns already here keep theirs. Each visitor gets at most one.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Experimental_Gap: Generation optimization is registered on this page. Other experiments are not added yet.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Experimental_Note: These options change how long visitors take to generate. With one off, visitors still use each incident's own apparel, history, health, and genes.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_OptimizeGeneration_Tooltip: Skips relations, titles, random apparel, and redressing world pawns. Incidents without a set xenotype draw from the gene page weights. If those weights are unavailable, visitors use the base ratkin xenotype. If that xenotype is missing, they use the famine ratkin xenotype.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Frequency_Gap: The curve is the chance this pool fires. Days run across. Chance runs up. The dot is the current setting. 0 turns this pool off. Rest the cursor on the curve to read that day's chance.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Developer_Note: Debug queues live under Dev events. Version and IrisMenus are under Compatibility and diagnostics.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_AidRequests_Tooltip: New aid and baby exchanges stop sending letters. An open request can still be delivered or refused.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_IntelTrades_Tooltip: New intel stops being traded for a site. Sites already placed stay on the world.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_VisitorChoices_Tooltip: New visitors stop asking to be taken in, hired, or sent away. The right-click menu still handles people already here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TraderIgnoreEnvironment_To: Famine traders do not leave as soon as they enter because of cold, heat, or dangerous weather. Off, harsh conditions still send them away.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TraderIgnoreEnclosed_Toolt: Famine traders stay inside a closed room instead of digging out. Off, they dig out when they cannot reach the map edge.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ChildExchangeFood: Allow food in place of children
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_ChildExchangeFood_Tooltip: Child exchange accepts simple meals instead of a baby. Each child costs 10. The traders do not sell food. Off, the trade still asks for the child.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_FamilyDrop_Tooltip: Mothers stop recording each child they set down. Records already written stay in the save.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_MotherFeed_Tooltip: Mothers stop walking over to feed a hungry child.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PrisonerScavenge_Tooltip: Hungry prisoners stop searching the ground for something edible.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TailBite_Tooltip: A hungry prisoner may bite a sleeping prisoner under 3. Off by default.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Broadcast_Tooltip: The comms console stops listing a broadcast. A cooldown already running does not end early.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Stagger_Tooltip: Queued incidents spawn one batch at a time. Off, queued incidents spawn as soon as they can.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PredationChance_Tooltip: Each camp map rolls this chance for a predator. 0 to 100, default 10. At 0, none arrive.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PredationFightBack_Tooltip: Off, hunted camp Ratkin run. Anyone who cannot use violence still cannot fight.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PredationFollowDifficulty: Outside predators follow the save difficulty once the Ratkin are gone
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PredationFollowDifficulty_: On, they resume normal hunting when no reachable Ratkin or corpse remains. Off, a hungry predator with nothing reachable leaves the map.
LanguageData.RHAH_Predation_Text: A wild predator has started hunting these Ratkin refugees. It goes for the young first.
LanguageData.RHAH_OutsidePredators_Text: A predator followed the Ratkin refugees here and is looking for one it can eat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Choice_Text: They want {0} {1}. Delivering sends them off. Refusing sends them off too. Ignoring leaves them as they are.
LanguageData.RHAH_Choice_Short: Not enough in storage. They need {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Choice_NoBaby: No prisoner or slave baby can be handed over.
LanguageData.RHAH_Choice_Stale: This letter has already been settled.
LanguageData.RHAH_Choice_Delivered: The goods have been handed over.
LanguageData.RHAH_Intel_Text: The trade is done. A site has appeared nearby.
LanguageData.RHAH_Broadcast_Cooldown: The broadcast is still cooling down
